The LG NANO 4K UHD AI TV NU885 has one simple goal, that is to make the whole viewing experience feel more complete, whether you're into films, sports or a late-night YouTube binge.
In this video, we look at LG's Linear Flow Design, the Nano Detail Enhancer with the Alpha 7 Gen9 AI Processor, 4K Super Upscaling, HDR10 Pro and Dolby Atmos. We also try the AI features - natural language search with Google Gemini, AI Voice ID, AI Picture and Sound Wizards, AI Agent, AI Concierge, and the AI Magic Remote.
